summary: Iteration 16: Tested catalog categories & tabs admin management (backend + frontend). All 9 pytest cases passed. Full E2E flow validated: create category -> create tab -> supplier creates listing -> tab filter returns it -> deactivate category -> new listing rejected (400) -> existing listing still has category_label -> inactive category hidden from /api/meta/categories -> reorder & delete tab works -> delete used category returns 400. Non-admin returns 403. Frontend: /katalog shows 6 seeded tabs (all/plywood/spc/wallpanel/services/assets). Admin /admin -> admin-tab-catalog -> catalog-manager renders with 15 category rows across material/service/asset columns, 6 tab rows, usage counts shown ('2 produk'), tab-dialog & category-dialog open with all expected testids present.

minor.issue: Uses db.listings.count_documents({'category':key}) WITHOUT is_active filter. This means categories referenced only by soft-deleted (is_active=False) listings cannot be hard-deleted — must either filter is_active=True (align with usage count in /admin/catalog which uses is_active=True) or purge inactive listings. Resulted in leftover TEST category being blocked from deletion during cleanup.

action_items: (Optional) In catalog.py delete_category, filter listings by is_active=True to make deletion consistent with the usage count shown in /admin/catalog; otherwise soft-deleted listings permanently block category deletion.
critical_code_review_comments: catalog.py:141 delete_category counts ALL listings for the category (including is_active=False), but admin_catalog usage count on line 111 filters is_active=True — this inconsistency can confuse admins (sees usage=0 but delete returns 400).

catalog.py:36 refresh() is called synchronously after each admin write but mutates module-level dicts (LABELS/ACTIVE/TAB_FILTERS). Under concurrent writes could race — acceptable for admin-only writes but worth noting.
server.py:375 validate_listing uses `body.type not in catalog.ACTIVE` which checks dict keys (TYPES). OK but slightly non-obvious.
seed_data_creation: All test categories/tabs/listings cleaned up. Also purged 242 leftover TEST-prefixed listings from prior iterations. Verified seeded 6 tabs & 15 categories intact; original tab order restored.

Backend endpoints under /api/admin/catalog, /api/admin/categories, /api/admin/tabs, /api/admin/catalog/reorder. Public: /api/catalog/tabs, /api/catalog/categories, /api/meta/categories, /api/listings?tab=KEY. Preview URL REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=https://matshop-3.preview.emergentagent.com.
rca of the issue: No critical issue found. Minor consistency gap in delete_category usage filter noted above.
